decision.rationale: Near right curb, parallel to centerline; motion unverified. Clear junction mouth ahead; approach before turning.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. Initial approach, 0 completed turns; next right at visible junction ahead.
decision.dynamics_note: Motion uncalibrated; baseline is not a motion sample. Car near right curb with clear approach ahead. Brief straight acceleration then coast to assess displacement before cornering.

decision.rationale: Right lane near curb, aligned with road; advanced toward pole. Crossing cars block the junction ahead.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. Initial approach, 0 completed turns; next right at junction ahead, yielding to crossing cars.
decision.dynamics_note: 38 throttle +22 coast advanced toward corner; prior empty inference showed no clear travel. Now moving forward with crossing traffic ahead; brake then hold, stopping not yet verified.

decision.rationale: Near right curb, parallel to road; little movement by pole. Junction ahead; crossing cars remain left of approach.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; approaching first right, curb mouth still ahead.
decision.dynamics_note: 16 brake +44 handbrake left car nearly fixed by curb; door opened then closed. Short forward approach should expose corner clearance; no steering until front clears near curb.

decision.rationale: Curb-side right lane, aligned; little advance by pole. Open door and person beside it; forward road gap clear.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; first right still ahead; door interaction interrupting approach.
decision.dynamics_note: 30 throttle +30 coast produced little advance; open door/person indicate interaction, not proven blockage. Longer straight throttle seeks clear forward escape; curb still limits right steering.

decision.rationale: At right curb, nose angled toward sidewalk; no advance past pole despite throttle. Steer away from curb.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; first right mouth ahead. Recover from curb/open-door interruption.
decision.dynamics_note: 60 throttle produced negligible displacement by pole; curb contact or door interruption likely. Try leftward forward escape, not more straight throttle; yaw may increase sharply if freed.

decision.rationale: Right curb, nose slightly into sidewalk; still fixed by pole after left throttle. Rear-left car limits reversing.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; first right mouth ahead. Curb recovery before approach.
decision.dynamics_note: 30 left-throttle +30 throttle gave no clear advance or yaw; forward escape failed. Try 30 straight reverse, then handbrake because rear-left car is close. Front clearance remains unverified.

decision.rationale: At right curb, angled into sidewalk; reversed toward rear-left car and shifted by pole. Forward-left gap is open.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; first right ahead. Reverse shifted car; recover lane before corner.
decision.dynamics_note: 30 reverse +30 handbrake visibly shifted rear left toward nearby car; nose remains curbward. No further rear clearance. Forward-left for40 aims to free front; release steering before speed builds.

decision.rationale: Curb-side right lane, now nearly parallel; advanced past pole as it fell. Right street mouth is just ahead.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; advanced to first right mouth, pole falling beside car; begin right after clearing curb.
decision.dynamics_note: 40 left-throttle +20 coast produced substantial forward travel and straighter heading; pole fell. Now moving, so use shorter steering after advancing beyond curb; brake limits junction drift.

decision.rationale: Entering junction from right lane, angled right but not aligned; advanced beyond near curb. Right mouth alongside, clear
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; first right underway, near curb cleared; finish aligning with destination right lane.
decision.dynamics_note: 25 throttle +25 right +10 brake advanced beyond curb with partial right yaw; turn incomplete. Handbrake held during inference. Add right arc, then coast; watch far curb as speed builds.

decision.rationale: Straddling centerline, still angled toward far curb; advanced toward pole. Right turn incomplete; car close on right.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; first right overshot toward centerline; finish yaw and recover destination right lane.
decision.dynamics_note: 40 right-throttle +20 coast advanced more than it turned; prior handbrake also allowed drift. Far curb/pole now close, car right limits arc. Brake with right yaw, brief powered turn, then hold.

decision.rationale: Beyond right lane, diagonal to centerline; little movement at pole after coasting into it. Rear roadway gap clear.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; first right overshot to pole; reverse clear, then recover destination right lane.
decision.dynamics_note: Coasting reached pole; 20 brake-right +25 throttle-right +15 handbrake barely moved nose. Likely pole blockage. Reverse-left 45 to clear front and rotate right; brake before rear gap is consumed.

decision.rationale: Reversed clear of pole; nearly parallel to road but straddling centerline. Right-lane gap open for recovery.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. First right heading achieved, lane recovery incomplete; pole cleared. Next: settle right lane, find next right.
decision.dynamics_note: 45 reverse-left +15 handbrake backed well clear of pole and rotated nearly parallel. Front now clear; right lane open. Brief forward-right then left correction aims to settle lane without curbward drift.

decision.rationale: Near centerline, nearly parallel to road; advanced past pole. Rightward lane recovery needed; no verified street mouth.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 1 right heading achieved; still near centerline on first leg. Next: recover right lane, find next right.
decision.dynamics_note: 20 forward-right +15 forward-left +25 coast advanced past pole, remaining nearly parallel near centerline. Moving now; shorten steering for gentle rightward recovery, then coast.
